name: Kodak Vericolor II Professional Film 4108, Type L
primary_revision: Kodak Publication E-77, September 1980, DS-8 page 62
process: C-41; tungsten 3200 K, 1 second; Status M densitometry; spectral sensitivity at density 1.0 above D-min.
adaptation: Digitized characteristic curves, spectral sensitivity, D-min and mid-scale combined spectral density from DS-8. The publication does not separate the three C/M/Y dye spectra; channel_density is the kodak_portra_160 donor. Base and mid-scale runtime source remain partially unverified. This is a public-data approximation, not a measured stock profile.
